- LEAF: no subagent dispatch; never git commit/push/merge/rebase/stash/checkout. Parent integrates+commits after the wave settles.
- Write only your own report + scratch inside your brief's scope. Never touch sibling lanes or shared state.

- Start by reading LOG.md tail, SCORECARD.md, prior round reports — cheap, parallel.
- Falsified claims are useful rounds — report measured outcomes honestly.
- Domain-facing actions (push/publish/upstream edits) are operator-owned.
